typing symbols that are not on the keyboard (arrows, dingbats, currency, fractions) into a price tag or label
checking which alternates a display font offers before choosing it for a poster
avoid: unattended pipelines: there is no script route; put the Unicode character straight into textItem.contents instead
fonts without OpenType alternates: the panel only shows the base character set
